title: Listening Drill — Community film night
description: Public announcement. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Community film night
sections.transcript:
ORGANISER: A quick update about community film night. Some of you have printed the original programme, so please take a moment to change your notes. The most important change concerns seat allocation.

ORGANISER: For now, go to the rear entrance. If that route is closed when you arrive, use the main lobby instead. It takes a few minutes longer, so allow enough time.

ORGANISER: Questions should go to Simon rather than the general enquiries desk. Before you leave, keep the aisles clear. We will post a further update only if another part of the plan changes.
